sections.title: Active ingredient (in each tablet)
sections.text: Naproxen sodium 220 mg (naproxen 200 mg) (NSAID)* *nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug

sections.title: Uses
sections.text: • temporarily relieves minor aches and pains due to: • minor pain of arthritis • muscular aches • backache • menstrual cramps • headache • toothache • the common cold • temporarily reduces fever

sections.title: Warnings
sections.text: Allergy Alert: Naproxen sodium may cause a severe allergic reaction, especially in people allergic to aspirin. Symptoms may include: • hives • facial swelling • asthma (wheezing) • shock • skin reddening • rash • blisters If an allergic reaction occurs, stop use and seek medical help right away. Stomach bleeding warning: This product contains NSAID, which may cause severe stomach bleeding. The chance is higher if you: • age 60 or older • have had stomach ulcers or bleeding problems • take a blood thinning (anticoagulant) or steroid drug • take other drugs containing prescription and nonprescription NSAIDs (aspirin, ibuprofen, naproxen or others) • have 3 or more alcoholic drinks every day while using this product • take more or for a longer time than directed Heart attack and stroke warning : NSAIDs, except aspirin, increase the risk of heart attack, heart failure, and stroke. These can be fatal. The risk is higher if you use more than directed or for longer than directed.

sections.title: Do not use
sections.text: • if you have ever had an allergic reaction to any other pain reliever/fever reducer • right before or after heart surgery

sections.title: Ask a doctor before use if
sections.text: • the stomach bleeding warning applies to you • you have a history of stomach problems, such as heartburn • you have high blood pressure, heart disease, liver cirrhosis, kidney disease, asthma, or had a stroke • you are taking a diuretic • you have problems or serious side effects from taking pain relievers or fever reducers

sections.title: Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are
sections.text: • under a doctor’s care for any serious condition • taking aspirin for heart attack or stroke, because naproxen may decrease this benefit of aspirin • taking any other drug

sections.title: When using this product
sections.text: • take with food or milk if stomach upset occurs

sections.title: Stop use and ask a doctor if
sections.text: • you experience any of the following signs of stomach bleeding: • feel faint • vomit blood • have bloody or black stools • have stomach pain that does not get better • you have symptoms of heart problems or stroke: • chest pain • trouble breathing • weakness in one part or side of body • slurred speech • leg swelling • pain gets worse or lasts more than 10 days • fever gets worse or lasts more than 3 days • you have difficulty swallowing • it feels like the pill is stuck in your throat • redness or swelling is present in the painful area • any new symptoms appear

code.displayName: OTC - PREGNANCY OR BREAST FEEDING SECTION

sections.title: If pregnant or breast-feeding,
sections.text: ask a health professional before use. It is especially important not to use naproxen sodium during the last 3 months of pregnancy unless definitely directed to do so by a doctor because it may cause problems in the unborn child or complications during delivery.

code.displayName: OTC - KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN SECTION

sections.title: Keep out of reach of children.
sections.text: In case of overdose, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away (1-800-222-1222).

sections.title: Directions
sections.text: • do not take more than directed • the smallest effective dose should be used • drink a full glass of water with each dose Adults and children 12 years and older: • take 1 tablet every 8 to 12 hours while symptoms last • for the first dose you may take 2 tablets within the first hour • do not exceed 2 tablets in any 8- to 12-hour period • do not exceed 3 tablets in a 24-hour period Children under 12 years: • ask a doctor

sections.title: Other information
sections.text: • each tablet contains : sodium 22 mg • store at 20-25°C (68-77°F). Avoid high humidity and excessive heat above 40°C (104°F).

sections.title: Inactive ingredients
sections.text: FD&C blue no. 2 aluminum lake, hypromellose, magnesium stearate, microcrystalline cellulose, polyethylene glycol, povidone, talc, titanium dioxide
